name: hud_ui_fill_bitmap_set_normalized_value_and_rebuild
description: HudUiFillBitmap::SetNormalizedValueAndRebuild stores the normalized value, invalidates the widget, and rebuilds fill/preview rectangles from the active images.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the coherent HudUiFillBitmap source/table cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4b86b0 returns when fillImage is null, stores normalizedValue, dispatches the active Invalidate slot, computes the filled width with _ftol, rebuilds fillRect/fill offsets, and conditionally rebuilds previewRect/preview offsets.

Native smoke zhud_fill_bitmap_core_smoke verifies SetNormalizedValueAndRebuild(0.25f) stores the normalized value, invalidates the widget, rebuilds fillRect from the fill image, rebuilds previewRect from the preview image, and leaves normalizedValue unchanged when fillImage is null.
